noPrices: Cardmarket prices aren’t available yet: values will appear after the next price update.
chartEmpty: No history for these filters: the chart builds up with each daily price update.

colHints.copies: Copies with a Cardmarket price / copies owned.
colHints.marketValue: Current value from the Cardmarket trend price (price × quantity).
colHints.marketVar: Change in market value over the selected period (Cardmarket price at the start of the period → current price).
colHints.invested: Sum of the purchase prices you entered, in euros (foreign-currency purchases converted at the ECB rate of the purchase day).
colHints.purchasePnL: Profit or loss since purchase: current market value minus entered purchase price (foreign-currency purchases converted to euros at the ECB rate of the purchase day), whatever the selected period. Card bought several times: only copies with a purchase price count.
colHints.card: Card or product name and number. One row per card: “2 purchases” shows each purchase.
colHints.purchase: Total purchase price entered. Below: the purchase date, or the average cost per copy for a card bought several times.
colHints.market: Current Cardmarket price: per unit and total for the quantity owned.

emptyFiltered: No owned cards match these filters.
detailHint: {count} {noun}. Enter a purchase price on a card sheet to compute profit or loss.
emptyCatalog: The card catalog isn’t available yet. Please try again later.
selectHint: Click a line: show only that line. Ctrl+click: add or remove a line. Alt+click a line, then click another: select every line in between. Click the name: open the card. Release Ctrl or Alt: only the selected lines stay listed; the × on the tag shows them all again.
pnlBasis: On {count} / {total} {n, plural, one {copy} other {copies}} with a purchase price
referenceError: Start-of-period prices unavailable: market changes are not shown.
selectHintTouch: Tap a card to tick it: the figures and the chart then cover only the ticked cards. Tap its name to open the card.
periodDetailAll: Change since the first price record
emptyCollectionBody: Add cards to track their Cardmarket value, your purchase prices and your gains or losses.
showMore: Show more · {count} {n, plural, one {card left} other {cards left}}
realizedDetail: From {count} {n, plural, one {sale} other {sales}} with a purchase price
unconverted: {n, plural, one {# foreign-currency purchase has no exchange rate yet: it is left out of invested and P&L.} other {# foreign-currency purchases have no exchange rate yet: they are left out of invested and P&L.}}

sell.title: Sell {name}
sell.available: {n, plural, one {# copy available} other {# copies available}}
sell.help: Sold copies leave your collection; their cost basis is kept to compute the realized gain. A sale can be undone from the sales list.
sell.pending: An offline change to this card has not been sent yet: try again once syncing is done.

alert.help: You are notified when the Cardmarket price reaches or exceeds this amount: on this page, and by notification if enabled in settings.
alert.reachedTitle: {n, plural, one {Resale price reached} other {Resale prices reached}}

sales.title: Sales
sales.hint: {count} {n, plural, one {sale} other {sales}}. Sold copies no longer count in value or unrealized P&L; the chart drops them on the sale day.

movers.empty: No price change over the period.
movers.concentrationTop: {n, plural, one {The most valuable card makes up} other {The # most valuable cards make up}} {share} of the value.

push.many: {count, plural, one {# card has reached} other {# cards have reached}} your resale price.
